args.title: Remember the last used export format
args.body:
File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Change this file to persist and load the selected export format using localStorage or a similar approach, so that the last used format is remembered and automatically selected the next time the export function is used. This change addresses the feature request to remember the last used format.

label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The file src/components/ExportButton.tsx manages the export format selection state, and the evidence suggests modifying it to persist and load the selected format (e.g., via localStorage) to remember the last used format. This file is directly responsible for controlling the export format, so it is the right place for the feature implementation.
